headline: Health alert: Dengue takes deadlier turn in Bangladesh
summary: Medical facilities are facing increased pressure as the virus becomes more severe.
details: The dengue situation in Bangladesh has entered a more dangerous phase, with reports indicating the virus is taking a deadlier turn.
Healthcare providers are seeing an increase in severe cases, putting additional strain on hospitals and medical resources.
Patients are being treated in overcrowded wards, with many requiring urgent care to manage critical symptoms.
Public health officials are urging citizens to take immediate precautions to prevent mosquito breeding and protect themselves from bites.
The surge in severe cases highlights the urgent need for enhanced vector control and early diagnosis to reduce mortality rates.

headline_marked: [[Milestone teacher killed]] in road accident in Dhaka's Khilgaon
headline: Milestone teacher killed in road accident in Dhaka's Khilgaon
summary: Tasfia Ahmed Tisha, 31, was hit by one bus and run over by another while returning home on Wednesday evening.
details: Tasfia Ahmed Tisha, a 31-year-old teacher at Milestone School and College in Aftabnagar, was killed in a tragic road accident in Dhaka's Khilgaon area on Wednesday evening.

The incident occurred around 5:45 PM on the main road in front of Basumati Hospital in Meradia. According to police, a bus from Ramzan Paribahan hit her, throwing her onto the road, where she was then run over by a bus from Tisha Paribahan.
Passers-by rescued her in critical condition and rushed her to Farazy Hospital. She was later shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared her dead around 9:30 PM.
Police have seized both buses involved in the accident. The driver of one bus and the helper of another have been detained for questioning.
Police are currently investigating whether Tisha was walking or traveling on a motorcycle at the time of the accident, as no motorcycle was found at the scene.
Tisha was originally from Chandpur Sadar upazila. She resided in the Meradia Nayapara area of Dhaka, while her husband lives abroad.
caption:
A college teacher was hit by one bus and run over by another in a horrific accident in Dhaka.

Tasfia Ahmed Tisha, a 31-year-old teacher at Milestone School and College in Aftabnagar, was killed in a tragic road accident in Dhaka's Khilgaon area on Wednesday evening.

The incident occurred around 5:45 PM on the main road in front of Basumati Hospital in Meradia. According to police, a bus from Ramzan Paribahan hit her, throwing her onto the road, where she was then run over by a bus from Tisha Paribahan.

Passers-by rescued her in critical condition and rushed her to Farazy Hospital. She was later shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared her dead around 9:30 PM.

Police have seized both buses involved in the accident. The driver of one bus and the helper of another have been detained for questioning.

Police are currently investigating whether Tisha was walking or traveling on a motorcycle at the time of the accident, as no motorcycle was found at the scene.

Tisha was originally from Chandpur Sadar upazila. She resided in the Meradia Nayapara area of Dhaka, while her husband lives abroad.
